notes: WIBOR: GPW Benchmark dane-opoznione (fetched 2026-11-27, HTTP 200 on the first request; rolling table 2026-01-02..2026-11-25). Only the rows dated C were extracted. The page now also carries text about the ON/SW discontinuation from 1 Oct 2026, which post-dates the window and was ignored. Cross-check: Erste (ex-Santander) Codziennik issued C+1, table 'Stawki WIBOR' (no 1Y). Ids: 169190, 169191, 169192, 169198, 169208, 169219, 169225, 169244, 169248, 169251, 169254, 169284, 169295, 169321, -, 169336, 169378, 169382, 169385, 169390 for C=31 Mar, 1, 2, 7, 8, 9, 10, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 27, 28, 29 Apr. ON/SW/1M/3M/6M match GPWB on all 18 dates where the issue holds C, and the labels are C. The value-minus-change column of every issue also reproduces the previous fixing. 1Y is single source; WIBID is stored too.

WIBOR exceptions. (1) C=13 Apr: the 14 Apr issue (169244) is stale. Its whole market page (FX session, fixing column, WIBOR, IRS, FRA, bond yields) is identical to the 13 Apr issue (169225) and labelled 10/04/2026: WIBOR = 10 Apr fixing (ON 3.72, 3M 3.84) and fixing column = NBP 10 Apr (069/A). Only the front-page text is new. The 13 Apr fixing is confirmed from the change column of the 15 Apr issue (169248): value - change = GPWB 13 Apr on all 5 tenors. (2) C=22 Apr: the archive has no issue dated 23 Apr. Item 169225 has a file-server stamp of 23 Apr 15:05, but its PDF is the 13 Apr issue (CreationDate 13 Apr 07:16 UTC). The 22 Apr fixing is confirmed from the change column of the 24 Apr issue (169336, labelled 23.04.2026). So every C is confirmed, directly or through the change column.

Good Friday / Easter: GPW Benchmark DID fix WIBOR on Fri 3 Apr 2026 (GPWB row 2026-04-03). WIBOR ON 3.61, SW 3.80, 1M 3.77, 3M 3.85, 6M 3.88, 1Y 3.90; WIBID ON 3.31, SW 3.60, 1M 3.57, 3M 3.65, 6M 3.68. There is no row for Mon 6 Apr. The 7 Apr Codziennik (169195, labelled 06/04/2026, though there was no fixing on 6 Apr) prints exactly the 3 Apr fixing with changes vs 2 Apr (ON -8, SW 0, 1M -5, 3M 0, 6M 0). Its fixing column is NBP 3 Apr, and its text says money-market rates moved negligibly on Friday. NBP published table 065/A/NBP/2026 on 3 Apr. On 3 and 6 Apr there was no EURIBOR (TARGET holiday), no PRIBOR (CZ holiday), no BUBOR (HU holiday) and no Catalyst session (no 3 Apr file; the URL redirects). The 3 Apr fixing is the latest WIBOR published before R=7 Apr. Per schema, by_date['2026-04-02'] keeps the C row (src_row_date = C). 3M/6M/1Y are the same on 2 and 3 Apr; only ON (3.69 -> 3.61) and 1M (3.82 -> 3.77) differ.

WIBOR 6M fixings 15-24 Apr (for May WZ coupon resets): 15 Apr 3.88, 16 Apr 3.88, 17 Apr 3.89, 20 Apr 3.89, 21 Apr 3.88, 22 Apr 3.88, 23 Apr 3.89, 24 Apr 3.90 (GPWB; Codziennik agrees on every date, 22 Apr through the change column of the 24 Apr issue).

WIBOR and the NBP: RPP held the reference rate at 3.75% on 9 Apr (Codziennik 10 Apr, id 169219). Fixings were flat all month: 3M 3.84-3.87, 6M 3.87-3.90, 1Y 3.88-3.94, 1M 3.74-3.82, SW 3.76-3.84. ON ranged 3.57-3.79; it peaked on 15 Apr at 3.79 (+6bp, equal to 1M) and was 3.57 on 28-29 Apr. Values are as published and confirmed by the Codziennik, not adjusted.

POLSTR/WIRON: keyed by index date ('Data wskaznika') from gpwbenchmark.pl/dane_opoznione (latest index date 2026-11-19). All 23 index dates 2026-03-27..2026-04-29 are present, including 2026-04-03 (Good Friday); there is no 6 Apr. The index dates equal the WIBOR fixing dates. CI accrual confirms the calendar: 2->3 Apr accrues 1 day at the 2 Apr rate and 3->7 Apr accrues 4 days at the 3 Apr rate; every other step matches POLSTR x days/365 to 0.01. published_by_convention = next GPW Benchmark business day (d+1 rule, not verified with timestamps): index 2 Apr -> 3 Apr (GPWB operated on Good Friday), index 3 Apr -> 7 Apr (6 Apr is Easter Monday), index 29 Apr -> 30 Apr (after the last C). 27 and 30 Mar are identical to the 2026-03 file. Month-end dip: index 31 Mar POLSTR 3.024 / WIRON 2.218 (30 Mar 3.414/3.269; 1 Apr 3.516/3.026). Low WIRON prints on 24 Apr (2.988) and 29 Apr (2.941); both are in the source.

EURIBOR: Bundesbank BBIG1 (published with a 1 working-day delay; values dated C; 'Stand vom 26.11.2026 13:24'). Single source, as in earlier runs. No value for 3 or 6 Apr (TARGET holidays); every C has a value. 27/30 Mar are identical to the 2026-03 file. 12M ran 2.870 (31 Mar) -> 2.872 (7 Apr) -> 2.680 (9 Apr; 8 Apr 2.860, the day the Codziennik reported the Middle East ceasefire, id 169198) -> 2.640 (22 Apr) -> 2.765 (29 Apr). 3M 2.079 -> 2.243 (14 Apr) -> 2.149.

PRIBOR: CNB year.txt 2026 (last row 19 Nov); all C are CZ fixing days (3 and 6 Apr have no rows: CZ holidays). 30 Mar is identical to the 2026-03 file. 3M 3.56-3.57 all month; 1Y 3.71 (31 Mar) -> 3.64 (16-21 Apr) -> 3.74 (29 Apr).

BUBOR: MNB bubor2.xls sheet 2026. Every C is a HU fixing day (3 and 6 Apr are HU holidays and not C), so date=C throughout. There was a sharp fall after the 12 Apr Hungarian election (Orban's party lost; forint +2.5-3%, Codziennik 13/14 Apr ids 169225/169244): 3M/6M/12M 6.38/6.52/6.68 (10 Apr) -> 6.30/6.38/6.48 (13 Apr) -> 6.25/6.25/6.31 by 24 Apr, flat to 29 Apr. MNB held the base rate at 6.25% on 28 Apr with hawkish guidance (Codziennik 29 Apr, id 169385), so the late-April 3M = base rate is genuine, not a data error.

NBP fx: api.nbp.pl table A 062..082/A/NBP/2026 for the C dates (065/A = 3 Apr, Good Friday, not a C). EUR/USD fixings match the Codziennik fixing column on all 18 directly covered dates. Exception: the stale 14 Apr issue shows the 10 Apr fixing (4.2534/3.6396) instead of 13 Apr (4.2507/3.6374). CHF is single source.

Catalyst: PRIMARY = official GPW Catalyst daily statistics, gpwcatalyst.pl/pub/CATALYST/statystyki/statystyki_dzienne/catalyst_YYYYMMDD.xls (April files still .xls; sheet 'instrumenty' layout unchanged). The month list for 04 has the 20 April sessions; there is no 3 Apr. Header date = C in all 20 files. Off-session sheet: no FPC rows on any C; block columns are 0. Mar 2 - Mar 30 official files were re-downloaded for last-trade lookback; their FPC rows reproduce the 2026-03 output exactly. Cross-check: biznesradar.pl notowania-historyczne pages 1-8 (coverage back to 2024/2025). Open/high/low/close/vol are identical on all 105 traded bond-days, and none of the 15 no-trade bond-days has a biznesradar row. Last-trade dates and closes from the official files agree with biznesradar.

Catalyst file timing: HTTP Last-Modified is on C (16:30-17:45 UTC) for 18 of 20 files. Exceptions: (a) C=8 Apr: Last-Modified 9 Apr 07:22 UTC (09:22 Warsaw) and internal last-saved 8 Apr 21:49 UTC (usual time ~16:25 UTC). The official file was apparently regenerated late and posted after the R=9 Apr 08:00 pre-open; the session prices themselves (same as biznesradar) were public on 8 Apr. (b) C=22 Apr: Last-Modified 23 Apr 10:05 UTC, internal save 22 Apr 16:25 UTC (normal), so the file was re-posted on 23 Apr; the first posting time is unknown. The content of both files agrees with biznesradar. Internal last-saved is on C 16:25-16:59 UTC except: 8 Apr (above); 31 Mar, which reads 'Sat Feb 28 16:25:56 2026'; and 30 Apr (not a C), which reads 'Tue Mar 31 16:26:12'. These are month-end metadata artefacts; the header date and content are C.

Catalyst units: official nominal = 1,000 PLN per bond. vol = number of bonds. turnover_pln = official 'Wartosc obrotu' (thous. PLN x 1000, includes accrued interest). biznesradar 'Obrot' is only vol x price(%) and is 10.02-10.25x smaller.

Catalyst traded=false (15 bond-days): vol=0 and close = last trade close on last_trade_date (not a C price; it equals the official closing and reference price on C). FPC0231 traded only 31 Mar (8 bonds, 2 trades, 100.78-102.49), 7 Apr (2, 103.15), 13 Apr (5, 104.94), 17 Apr (20, 103.68), 20 Apr (20, 104.68), 24 Apr (14, 104.37), 27 Apr (954 in 3 trades, 103.37) and 28 Apr (30, 102.32). No trade: 1-2 Apr (last 31 Mar), 8-10 Apr (last 7 Apr), 14-16 Apr (last 13 Apr), 21-23 Apr (last 20 Apr), 29 Apr (last 28 Apr); 12 bond-days in total. FPC0229 no trade 9 Apr (last 8 Apr, 102.45, 54). FPC0733 no trade 29 Apr (last 28 Apr, 81.35, 1,438). FPC0332 no trade 28 Apr (last 27 Apr, 95.06, 890). FPC0630 and FPC0235 traded on every C.

Catalyst thin/suspicious (medians over traded C: FPC0229 54, FPC0630 490, FPC0231 17, FPC0733 30, FPC0235 1,744, FPC0332 251). FPC0231: every print is tiny and jumpy: 31 Mar +1.49 vs 26 Mar on 8 bonds with an intraday range of 1.71; 13 Apr +1.79 on 5 bonds; 17 Apr -1.26; 20 Apr +1.00; 27 Apr -1.00 on 954 bonds (~56x median); 28 Apr -1.05 on 30 bonds. It was stale for 3 sessions three times. The direction is consistent with FPC0235 (7->13 Apr +1.67). FPC0229: 20 Apr 3,833 bonds in 2 trades (~71x median); 17 Apr 1,100 (~20x); 24 Apr 1 bond; 21 and 28 Apr 4 bonds. FPC0733: 28 Apr 1,438 bonds in a single trade (~48x median); 24 Apr 1 bond; 21 Apr 4. FPC0630: 13 Apr 1 bond (90.40); 29 Apr 5 bonds; intraday ranges of ~1pt on 1, 10, 14, 15, 16 and 20 Apr. FPC0235: 8 Apr +1.43 to 102.10 on 217 bonds (ceasefire day, Codziennik 8 Apr id 169198); heavy 14 Apr 11,049 and 16 Apr 9,489; it then fell from 102.80 (17/20 Apr) to 100.25 (29 Apr) on rising volume (4,290; 6,319) as oil rose again (Codziennik 29-30 Apr). FPC0332: 1 Apr close 94.55 (-1.05), then 95.30; 9 Apr low 94.55 vs close 95.75; 13 and 14 Apr one trade each at 95.90 (223 and 224 bonds; different trades, turnover differs).

Coupons: none of the six bonds has a coupon date in the window (FPC0229/0231/0235 pay on 3 Feb, FPC0332 on 3 Mar, FPC0630 on 5 Jun, FPC0733 on 21 Jul). Accrued interest rises monotonically on every C, and FPC0332's current coupon stays at 3.72% (set 3 Mar). Prices are clean.

New lines: none. The BGK (ISIN PL00005...) and PFR instrument set on Catalyst is the same in every April file as on 30/31 Mar. BGK: FPC0229, FPC0231, FPC0235, FPC0328, FPC0332, FPC0342, FPC0427, FPC0630, FPC0631, FPC0733, FPC1140, BGK1127, FPU1130, FWA0931 and IWS0645. PFR: PFR0330, PFR0627, PFR0827, PFR0927 and PF10927. No FWSZ-named line exists. FWA0931 (PL0000500492, BGK floater, coupon reset 4.62% -> 3.80% on 15 Mar, first shown 16 Mar) predates April. The only state-related addition is the Treasury bond DS0436 (PL0000119087), listed from 28 Apr (not BGK). OK0426 was last listed on 21 Apr.

Other source notes: from 27 Apr the Codziennik appears in the Erste Bank Polska layout (4 pages); its tables are unchanged. Several issues use dd/mm/yyyy and decimal points, the rest dd.mm.yyyy and commas. File-server stamps of late uploads: 1 Apr 15:06, 7 Apr 13:39, 10 Apr 12:57, 27 Apr 12:24 (PDF CreationDate 09:56 UTC), 30 Apr 10:30. The other PDFs were created 06:04-07:16 UTC on the issue date. Rates were used for levels only. GPWB operational communique of 2 Apr 13:14: bond-index values at 10:15 on 2 Apr were computed from 1 Apr TBSP prices (no TBSP fixing); relevant to curve work, not to these fixings.

No gaps: every requested field for every C has a value; no interpolation or memory used. Single-source fields: WIBOR 1Y, NBP CHF, EURIBOR, PRIBOR, BUBOR, POLSTR/WIRON. The Codziennik cross-check for C=13 and 22 Apr is indirect (through the change column).
